title: Kind of Blue
label: Columbia
tagline: Five pieces, two sessions, very little rehearsal. Davis handed his sextet a few scales and sketches and let them find the music in real time, and made the jazz record that people who "don't listen to jazz" tend to own anyway.
sessionsText: Columbia's 30th Street Studio in New York, a converted church known for its natural reverb. Davis arrived with sketches rather than full arrangements, and the band met most of the material in the studio.

sessions.label: 1959 · Session one
sessions.tracks: So What · Freddie Freeloader · Blue in Green

tracks.title: So What
tracks.note: Opens with a quiet piano-and-bass exchange before the horns answer with two notes. The whole tune moves between just two scales.

tracks.title: Freddie Freeloader
tracks.note: The one straight-ahead blues on the record, and the only track with Wynton Kelly at the piano instead of Bill Evans.

tracks.title: Blue in Green
tracks.note: Cannonball Adderley sits this one out. Credited to Davis, though Evans long maintained he wrote it.

tracks.title: All Blues
tracks.note: A blues in a rolling 6/8 lilt, built over a repeating bass figure.

tracks.title: Flamenco Sketches
tracks.note: Five scales, played in order. Each soloist decides how long to stay on each one before moving to the next.

world.what: Batista flees Cuba and Fidel Castro's revolutionaries take power.
Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens and The Big Bopper die in a plane crash in Iowa.
Barbie makes her debut at the American Toy Fair in New York.
Hawaii becomes the 50th US state, four days after this album comes out.

alsoThisYear.title: The Shape of Jazz to Come

trivia: For decades, side A played slightly sharp: a tape machine at the first session ran a little slow. Later reissues corrected the pitch.
In his liner notes, Bill Evans compares the music to a Japanese art form in which the painter must work in one spontaneous stroke, with no chance to correct.
It is regularly cited as the best-selling jazz album of all time.

quiz.question: On how many of the five tracks does Wynton Kelly replace Bill Evans at the piano?
quiz.explanation: Only Freddie Freeloader, the album's one conventional blues.

quiz.question: Where was Kind of Blue recorded?
quiz.explanation: Columbia's 30th Street Studio, a former church in Manhattan.

quiz.question: Who wrote the album's original liner notes?
quiz.explanation: Bill Evans, who also played piano on four of the five tracks.
